subject: HELLENIC NAVY AND AIRFORCE WILL MAKE A WITHOUT FIRING EXERCISE
text:
A4361/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QWELW/IV/BO /W /000/280/3459N02352E133 A) LGGG  PART 1 OF 2  B) 2612030700  C) 2612031130  D) 0700-0730 1100-1130  E) HELLENIC NAVY AND AIRFORCE WILL MAKE A WITHOUT FIRING EXERCISE 
WITHIN ATHINAI FIR/ HELLAS UIR AS DESCRIBED BELOW:
1.- EXERCISE AREA (WITHOUT FIRING): 362000N 0213900E - 362900N 
0224400E - 345900N 0233000E - 343000N 0233000E - 345700N 0222500E - 
362000N 0213900E.
AWYS B1 AND Y151 (ARLOS-PLH), L/UL604 (TRL-DILMO), M/UM872 
(KFN-ETILI), M/UM872 (ETILI-PLH), P/UP32 (NEVIK-EBOKA), M/UM729 
(PLH-TITUS), L/UL81 (METRU-TETUZ), M/UM728 (RERSA-SALUN), L/UL144, 
M/UM978 (DEMAG-PLH), LGR50, KALAMATA MTMA AFFECTED.
2.- EXERCISE AREA (WITHOUT FIRING): 350000N 0233000E -  
345400N 0254100E - 341100N 0262100E - 341100N 0250800E -
343000N 0233100E - 350000N 0233000E.
AWYS M/UM872 (METRU-PLH), L/UL604 (PLH-SALUN), L/UL81 (METRU-TETUZ), 
P/UP868, N/UN4, M/UM728 (GAVDO-SALUN), LGR27, IRAKLION TMA AFFECTED.
3.- PROCEDURES FOR EXERCISE AIRCRAFT:
3.1.- EXERCISE ACFT WILL FLY VFR/VMC IN ACCORDANCE WITH ICAO
RULES AND PROCEDURES AS AMPLIFIED IN AIP-GREECE.
3.2.- EXERCISE ACFT WILL SUBMIT FLIGHT PLANS AND WILL NOT ENTER
CONTROLLED AIRSPACE, UNLESS PRIOR PERMISSION HAS BEEN OBTAINED BY
APPROPRIATE ATS UNITS.
4.- PROCEDURES FOR NON EXERCISE ACFT:
4.1.- IN THE INTEREST OF SAFETY DURING END PART 1 OF 2
A4361/26 NOTAMN Q) LGGG/QWELW/IV/BO /W /000/280/3459N02352E133 A) LGGG  PART 2 OF 2  B) 2612030700  C) 2612031130  D) 0700-0730 1100-1130  E) THE EXERCISE, NON EXERCISE
ACFT ARE STRONGLY ADVISED NOT TO FLY WITHIN THE AREAS
DESIGNATED IN PARAS (1) AND (2) ABOVE.
4.2.- ACFT UNABLE TO AVOID THE EXERCISE AREAS WILL BE AUTHORIZED TO
ENTER THESE AREAS AFTER SPECIAL PERMISSION BY APPROPRIATE ATC UNIT. END PART 2 OF 2 F) SFC  G) FL280
